test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 01 Dec, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: 400 men have provisions for 23 weeks. They are joined by 60 men. How long will the provisions last?
solution:
**Given:**

Initial number of men = 400

Initial duration of provisions = 23 weeks

Additional men joined = 60

Total men = 400 + 60 = 460

**Formula Used:**

Men × Weeks = Constant

**Calculation:**

Initial Men × Initial Weeks = Total Men × New Weeks

400 × 23 = 460 × New Weeks

⇒ New Weeks = (400 × 23) / 460

⇒ New Weeks = 9200 / 460

⇒ New Weeks = 20 weeks

**The provisions will last for 20 weeks.**
